newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-GRIQUAS 123-7 AT LUNCH AGAINST NATAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GRIQUAS 123-7 AT LUNCH AGAINST NATAL.

text.p: Griqualand West, 322 behind on first innings, were 123 for seven in their second innings at lunch on the third day of their four-day Supersport Series cricket match against Natal at Kingsmead on Monday.
Griqualand West 91 and 123-7 (Derek Crookes 4-28). Natal 413-3 declared (Errol Stewart 82, Derek Crookes 128 not out, Dale Benkenstein 101 not out).
